reason: A DeepSeek Harness interface-customization plugin that simplifies the UI, applies preset chat modes, manages a DeepSeek API key and balance display, and can enable unrestricted agent access; human review is warranted because it removes approval prompts and grants full machine access.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供免设置聊天界面，自动应用模型与代理预设、隐藏高级控件，并提供 API 密钥与权限模式管理。
summaries.en: Provides a simplified no-setup DeepSeek Harness interface that applies model and agent presets, hides advanced controls, and manages API key and permission modes.

capabilities: Hides and replaces advanced user-interface elements
Automatically changes model, agent preset, input behavior, and thinking settings
Stores and uses a DeepSeek API key to display account balance
Enables full-access agent permissions without approval prompts in no-setup mode
Provides web search and web fetch in Chat mode
